title: Extension of a Galois automorphism to an algebraically closed overfield
statement: Let $K,K_s,\Omega$ be fields in one universe, with compatible embeddings $K\to K_s\to\Omega$ [def-pc-field-extension], with $K_s$ a separable closure of $K$ [def-pd-separable-closure] and $\Omega$ algebraically closed. For every $K$-automorphism $g$ of $K_s$ there is a $K$-automorphism $\tau$ of $\Omega$ such that $i\circ g=\tau\circ i$, where $i:K_s\to\Omega$ is the given embedding. No algebraicity of $\Omega/K$ is assumed.

source.place: Tag 03QW, section-galois-action-stalks, paragraph after example-nonalgebraic-point: restriction Aut(Omega/K) to Gal(Ks/K) is surjective; checked at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03QW

proof.text: Choose a transcendence basis B of Omega over Ks, using exists_isTranscendenceBasis. Let A be the polynomial subalgebra generated by B over Ks. Omega is an algebraic closure of A (equivalently of its fraction field), using IsAlgClosed.isAlgClosure_of_transcendence_basis.

Algebraic independence identifies A with MvPolynomial B Ks via hB.1.aevalEquiv. Conjugate MvPolynomial.mapEquiv B g.toRingEquiv by this identification to construct a ring automorphism f of A. On constants it sends x to g(x): e.symm.commutes, MvPolynomial.map_C, and e.commutes prove the equality hf.

Apply uniqueness of algebraic closures to the two algebra structures twisted by f, implemented by IsAlgClosure.equivOfEquiv, to obtain a ring automorphism t of Omega extending f. Its algebraMap formula and the scalar tower give ht: t(i(x)) = i(g(x)). Since g fixes K, ht proves that t fixes K. Package t as a K-algebra equivalence and prove the requested equality of ring homomorphisms by extensionality.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_algEquiv_extending_separableClosure
    (K Ks Ω : Type u) [Field K] [Field Ks] [Field Ω]
    [Algebra K Ks] [IsSepClosure K Ks] [Algebra Ks Ω] [Algebra K Ω]
    [IsScalarTower K Ks Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (g : Gal(Ks/K)) :
    ∃ τ : Ω ≃ₐ[K] Ω,
      (algebraMap Ks Ω).comp g.toRingHom =
        τ.toRingHom.comp (algebraMap Ks Ω)
